5824.title: Notification preview block filtering
5824.rootCauseOneLine: The preview collector accepts app directives, table rows, and JSON paragraphs as prose, preventing later summaries and empty-preview fallback.

prReviews.topFinding: Diff targets the reproduced parser gap; table heuristic coverage remains a review consideration.

5824.proposedFix: Skip non-prose blocks in the existing preview collector and preserve the sender fallback; do not duplicate open PR #5825.
5824.caveats: Pure text-boundary reproduction and source tracing only; no real device delivery or production frequency measurement. Same-agent repeat in a second clean checkout.
